author: Nicholas Rodriguez
title: Luis Robert Jr. (back) runs bases Thursday
desc: Luis Robert Jr. ran the bases on Thursday.
impact: Robert has been sidelined since late April with a lumbar spine disc herniation. He took batting practice in a cage on Tuesday, and Mets manager Carlos Mendoza said he looked normal and is pretty much symptom-free. Robert will continue to ramp up his running progression before beginning a minor league rehab assignment. Fantasy managers can expect him back at some point in the second half of the season.

author: Nicholas Rodriguez
title: Carlos Estevez (shoulder) to throw bullpen session Saturday
desc: Carlos Estevez is scheduled to throw a bullpen session on Saturday.
impact: Esteves, who has been recovering from a right rotator cuff strain since March 29, reportedly felt good following his Wednesday bullpen session. He has thrown two bullpens thus far and is scheduled for a third on Saturday. If all goes well, he could progress to facing live hitters next week. Fantasy managers should expect him to return in July.

author: Nicholas Rodriguez
title: Kris Bubic (elbow) to throw two innings at Triple-A Saturday
desc: Kris Bubic is scheduled to throw two innings with Triple-A Omaha on Sunday.
impact: Bubic resumed his rehab assignment on Wednesday, tossing a 1-2-3 inning. He is expected to work two innings in his next outing and should be activated from the injured list before the All-Star break.

author: Nicholas Rodriguez
title: Tanner Houck (elbow) begins light mound work
desc: Tanner Houck has begun light mound work.
impact: Houck underwent a hybrid reconstruction of his right UCL with flexor tendon repair last August and has officially begun light mound work. However, fantasy managers should not expect him to return until late in the season, as he still needs a couple of months to continue ramping up his throwing program before beginning a rehab assignment.

author: Nicholas Rodriguez
title: Matthew Boyd tosses 4.2 scoreless innings in return
desc: Matthew Boyd gave up no runs on four hits and four walks while striking out four across 4.2 innings in Thursday's 4-3 victory over the New York Mets.
impact: Boyd made his return to the starting rotation after being sidelined since May 6 with a left meniscus and shoulder injury, and did not allow an earned run across 76 pitches. While he struggled with command, issuing a season-high four walks, he was able to work out of jams when needed. He owns a 5.02 ERA and 1.36 WHIP with 35 strikeouts across 28.2 innings this season. His next scheduled start is on Wednesday against the San Diego Padres.

author: Nicholas Rodriguez
title: Steven Matz (ankle) placed on IL
desc: The Tampa Bay Rays placed Steven Matz on the 15-day injured list with a left ankle sprain.
impact: Matz reportedly entered his Tuesday outing against the Kansas City Royals with a sore ankle, and the injury worsened during the game, forcing him to the injured list after allowing five earned runs on six hits in just two innings of relief. He struggled mightily in June, posting a 14.54 ERA and 2.19 WHIP across 8.2 innings. In a corresponding move, Michael Grove was recalled from Triple-A Durham.

author: Nicholas Rodriguez
title: Cedric Mullins II steals base Thursday
desc: Cedric Mullins II went 2-for-4 with two runs scored and a stolen base in Thursday's 13-2 victory over the Kansas City Royals.
impact: Mullins has been generating some buzz in deeper leagues as a waiver wire pickup, and he continues to make a case for himself. Despite a rough season overall, he has been much better in June, slashing .259/.368/.414 with three home runs and three stolen bases this month.

author: Nicholas Rodriguez
title: Jonathan Aranda records three-hit game Thuesday
desc: Jonathan Aranda went 3-for-5 with a double, two runs scored and an RBI in Thursday's 13-2 victory over the Kansas City Royals.
impact: Aranda is swinging a hot bat, recording his third straight multi-hit game and extending his hitting streak to eight games. Despite a strong .366 OBP in June, he has been lacking in the power department with just one home run and a .354 slugging percentage this month. Fantasy managers should not be concerned, however, as his season-long numbers remain strong with 12 home runs and a .457 slugging percentage on the year.

author: Nicholas Rodriguez
title: Victor Mesa Jr. logs homer in blowout win Thursday
desc: Victor Mesa Jr. went 1-for-3 with a three-run home run and a walk in Thursday's 13-2 victory over the Kansas City Royals.
impact: Mesa hit a 355-foot opposite-field home run in the fourth inning off Seth Lugo. In 50 at-bats with the Tampa Bay Rays this season, he owns a .180 average and .665 OPS with three home runs. Despite the homer on Thursday, he is best left on waivers.

author: Nicholas Rodriguez
title: Ian Seymour dominates with 6.2 hitless innings Thursday
desc: Ian Seymour served as the bulk reliever in Thursday's 13-2 victory over the Kansas City Royals, tossing 6.2 hitless innings while allowing just one walk and striking out seven on 90 pitches.
impact: While Seymour did not draw the start on Thursday, he still logged a season-high 6.2 innings and seven strikeouts. He has been excellent in June, holding hitters to a .167 average while posting a 3.86 ERA and 0.95 WHIP. He is expected to take the mound again on Wednesday in a rematch against the Royals.

author: Nicholas Rodriguez
title: Junior Caminero goes yard three times Thursday
desc: Junior Caminero went 3-for-5 with three home runs, three runs scored and six RBI in Thursday's 13-2 victory over the Kansas City Royals.
impact: Caminero recorded his first career three-homer game, combining for 1,152 feet worth of home runs. He hit two off Seth Lugo and a third off shortstop Tyler Tolbert, who entered to pitch late in the game to preserve Kansas City's bullpen. Caminero leads all third basemen with 19 home runs and owns a career-best .285 average and .896 OPS across 78 games this season.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Brandon Lowe goes deep Thursday
desc: Brandon Lowe went 2-for-4 with a home run in the Pirates 5-1 win over the Mariners on Thursday.
impact: Lowe got the scoring going early with a solo blast in the first inning off Brandon Lowe. It was his 19th home run on the season and fifth in June.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Henry Davis hits home run Thursday
desc: Henry Davis went 2-for-3 with a home run in the Pirates 5-1 win over the Mariners on Thursday.
impact: Davis extended the Pirates lead to 3-0 with a two-run long ball off Bryce Miller. He also stole his second base of the season.  He is still slashing just .148/.247/.319 on the year.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Bubba Chandler earns win Thursday
desc: Bubba Chandler allowed one run on five hits over 5 1/3 innings with four strikeouts and three walks in a win on Thursday against the Mariners.
impact: Chandler posted one of his better recent outings against a struggling Seattle lineup. He did not struggle with his command outside of the fifth inning when he walked back-to-back hitters, but he escaped the frame allowing just one run. He'll face the Phillies next.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Bryce Miller strikes out 11 in loss Thursday
desc: Bryce Miller allowed three runs on five hits over 5 2/3 innings with 11 strikeouts in a loss on Thursday against the Pirates.
impact: Miller allowed a pair of home runs for the three runs he allowed. The Mariners offense scored three runs or less for the 11th straight game so as soon as he allowed those three runs, it was an uphill battle for Seattle to win the game. Miller did his job with 11 strikeouts and pitching into the sixth inning. He'll carry a strong 1.97 ERA into his next start against the Angels.
